title: DroneSecKB
description: A maintained reference for unmanned-aircraft-system (UAS) security: the OWASP Drone Top 10, a curated CVE register, a UAS-specific attack taxonomy, defensive controls, and shippable detection signatures.
data_note: All figures on this site are computed at build time from the JSON files in /data. They cannot drift from the underlying records.
pipeline_note: Drone/UAV CVEs are pulled from the NVD 2.0 API by fetch_cves.py on a schedule via GitHub Actions and written to data/cves_auto.json; hand-curated records in cves.json always take precedence. Counts and the rendered page are regenerated by build.py on each update. The register is not real-time: it refreshes on the workflow schedule.
nvd_attribution: This product uses the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
